reception: Reception concentrates in the stream-programming community the work grew from. The catalog of stream processing optimizations in ACM Computing Surveys records the transformations with this paper among its sources, and detailed discussions outnumber extensions: Moonen's work on predictable embedded multiprocessor architectures carried the cache-aware view to streaming applications on multiprocessor systems-on-chip, later work on generalized cache tiling for dataflow programs measures against the fusion strategy, and stream-processing optimizations for mobile sensing use it as a point of comparison. Others reuse the StreamIt benchmarks the evaluation established, software-pipelined execution of stream programs on GPUs among them. The record is modest in size but grounded: most citations come from people working on the same problem.
